deploy-bot: [deploy] START: staged canary for service=inference-runtime tag=v2.7.1-canary commit=7a9c3f env=prod-canary rollout=5% initiated by @release-manager :rocket:
carla: ack. I'll watch infra + app metrics for the next 20m. starting smoke run now.
alex: quick sanity: local smoke passed, basic responses look good.
sre-oncall: FYI seeing 1 alert spike on gpu-pool-3 memory 10m ago, not sure if correlated. digging in.
carla: tracing + logs: no error spikes tied to the new image. p95 latency ~180ms, error rate ~0.06% (baseline 0.05%). tagging for follow-up.
deploy-bot: health-check summary @ 5% after 12m — p50=28ms p95=179ms errors=0.06% tokens/s stable. logs: no new 5xx. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/abcd1234
release-manager: good first check. propose promote to 25% after another 15m if no regression.
sre-oncall: +1. alerts thin out, replayed a couple failing traces — unrelated GC noise.
carla: running a broader load test now (k6) against the canary pool. quick snippet I used:
```
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m smoke-script.js --summary-export=summary.json
```
carla: k6 summary looks fine: p99 < 420ms, no 5xx, throughput steady.
deploy-bot: [deploy] PROMOTE: rolling canary -> 25% (tag=v2.7.1-canary) at 1925001260. initiated by automation policy: staged-after-smoke.
release-manager: holding for one more quick check from infra (batching/caching) before next step.
sre-oncall: infra confirms cache hit-rate stable, autoscaler healthy.
carla: I'm pinning experiment 123 to the canary tag for evaluation: `/rollout pin inference-runtime v2.7.1-canary --scope=experiment-123 --expires=2026-04-01`
release-manager: note: we'll keep a soft pin on traffic split until EOD, then promote full if clear.
deploy-bot: [deploy] PROMOTE: 25% -> 50% at 1925001280. health checks green.
alex: load traces look normal across regions. no hotspotting.
sre-oncall: monitoring shows a small latency bump in eu-west-1 (p95 +20ms) — trending down after cache warming. continuing to watch.
carla: adjusting batching config for the canary to reduce p95; will apply a minor config patch if trend doesn't recover in 10m.
release-manager: decision: proceed to full promote if no regressions in next 10m.
deploy-bot: [deploy] PROMOTE: 50% -> 100% at 1925001295. tag promoted to stable v2.7.1, release artifact: git://repo/infra@v2.7.1
deploy-bot: [deploy] FINISH: canary complete. total duration 61m. final summary: p50=30ms p95=185ms errors=0.055% tokens/s nominal. no rollback required. changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.7.1
release-manager: merging release notes and notifying #general. nice work all :tada:
carla: follow-up items: open PR to tweak default batching window (minor perf tweak), and a note to pin quantization profile for the new tag.
sre-oncall: closing watch; will keep an eye overnight.
alex: thumbs up, will patch one flaky test mentioned in CI yesterday.
release-manager: done. marking deploy as successful and updating the release board.
